title: OmegaLite
description: OmegaLite is a modpack focused on optimization, with a few mods and a 100% Vanilla experience.
body:
OmegaLite is a lightweight optimization-focused modpack for Fabric 1.21.11, designed to deliver maximum performance with a minimal mod count, while preserving a true vanilla gameplay experience.

Unlike other optimization modpacks, OmegaLite focuses strictly on what actually matters: rendering, CPU efficiency, and client-side performance. It avoids unnecessary tweaks, visual clutter, or feature bloat that can negatively impact performance. Most included mods are client-side only and carefully selected to ensure they work together instead of counteracting each other.

OmegaLite was created on December 30, 2025, after its creator found that popular modpacks like Fabulously Optimized and Simply Optimized improved performance, but often at the cost of complexity and excessive mod counts. OmegaLite was born from the idea that less can do more.

The performance gains are measurable.
![Comparative image with Vanilla.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8c318a0b1567b8e30db89612e771cef93af53a07.png)
In a controlled test using identical settings and the same world:

Minecraft Vanilla: 221 FPS

OmegaLite: 335 FPS

That is a +114 FPS increase, clearly demonstrating OmegaLite’s superior performance over vanilla Minecraft.

OmegaLite is ideal for:
Low-end and mid-range PCs
iGPU-based systems
Players who want pure performance without sacrificing the vanilla feel

No unnecessary features.
No gimmicks.
Just optimized Minecraft.
